Name: Auto-Replace Tackles Bait and Ammo
Author: JonathanFeenstra
Description:
[size=4][b]Auto-Replace Tackles, Bait & Ammo[/b][/size]
Automatically replace broken tackles and depleted bait from fishing rods and ammo from slingshots if more is found in your inventory.

Includes configuration settings to:
[list]
[*]Toggle auto-replacement on/off for each attachment type (tackles, bait, or ammo) individually[/*]
[*]Toggle on/off per attachment type the requirement that the replacement must match the original item type (e.g., whether to allow the attached bait to be replaced by other types of bait when depleted)[/*]
[/list]Supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] to change the settings from the in-game menu.
